marie: Quick spotcheck after the launch — sessions up 320% but demo-starts flat. Can someone validate attribution coverage before Monday KPI?
zack: Seen it. Top ref=social spike but demo rate from that cohort is near zero.
ivy: Ran a tiny check: select count(*) filter (where utm_source is null) as no_utm, count(*) as total from sessions where occurred_at > now() - interval '24 hours'; result ~28% no_utm.
marie: 28% is high. Did we use shortlinks or partner redirects?
ivy: Shortlinks for paid socials, partner links for a few mentions. ops-bot: shortlink-service deployed at 09:20 UTC (sha: c9d2f) preserve_qs=false.
zack: That explains it. Action items: 1) ivy to run backfill (click->session match) 2) marie to add unattributed_pct tile to KPI dashboard 3) ivy to update weekly deck pre/post snapshots.
ivy: Backfill job started (job id bf-349876-01). ETA ~5h. I'll push interim CSV to /reports/launch_backfill_partial.csv.
marie: Also please add a one-line note for the exec slide: "Initial dashboard undercounted attributed demos; numbers updated after tracking backfill."
data-bot: Metric added: unattributed_pct = unattributed_sessions / total_sessions. Alert threshold set at 20% (notify #marketing).
ops-bot: Hotfix PR opened for shortlinks: https://git.company/shortener/pull/522 (preserve_qs=true). Canary deploying.
zack: If backfill recovers >60% of missing UTMs, we'll annotate and avoid escalation. If not, we'll plan CTA A/B and nurture sequence.
ivy: Backfill progress: 40% matched so far (1,120/2,800). Posting pre-snapshot: https://app.company/dashboards/kpi/snapshots/3498765432_pre.png
marie: Thanks — keep updates in this thread so Friday's KPI deck has a single source. :thumbsup:
